effect_description_eng:
[On Play] You may place up to 5 level 5 red and/or black cards with the [Cyborg] trait and different card numbers from your hand and/or trash in this card's digivolution cards to gain 1 memory for each card placed.
[All Turns] This Digimon's DP can't be reduced.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash 2 level 5 Digimon cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards to prevent this Digimon from being deleted.
